verdict: Leads are efficient; turning those leads into appointments is the focus now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.90 per lead — and efficiency is actually improving, with cost per lead down 26% compared to the prior week even as spend was reduced. The dip in spend this week drove a modest 9% dip in leads, which is the expected relationship; Meta is not underperforming, it is running leaner. The sharper issue is downstream: 81 opportunities have been created in your contact system this period, yet zero have converted to a booked appointment, and a broader contact overhang suggests leads are arriving but not being scheduled. Closing that intake gap is the priority for the coming week, and the full picture will be confirmed once attribution and contact cleanup — both in progress — are complete by end of August.
